doe-osti-2584711-early-stages-of-age-har: Uranium-niobium age hardening got its early stages, and this DOE report tests the twin reorientation hypothesis. The pages detail the energy barrier. The metallurgists get their data. The alloy was U-6%Nb. The hypothesis was twin reorientation. The metallurgists got data.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-WHNB_WHNB: A news contact card for WHNB-TV, channel 30 in Hartford, Connecticut, is all that survives in this file. Contact cards were working tools in television newsrooms, holding the names and numbers producers needed fast. The fragment is minor on its own, but it shows the ordinary paperwork that sat behind broadcast journalism. It was kept among research files on media and the assassination story.
